t: The District receives funding from a variety of sources. They include sewer service fees, treatment fees from PBCSD, reimbursement from the Reclamation Project, property tax revenue, interest income, and funds from the participants in the Highlands Bond issuance that cover all debt service.

t: Wastewater service fees account for approximately 53.8% of total budgeted operating revenues for 2024-25. Additional treatment fees from wastewater coming from PBCSD account for another 10% of operating revenues.
